invariants: required text rejects null, non-string, empty, and whitespace-only values
every record requires the exact supported schema version
task IDs, trajectory IDs, transition IDs, and state IDs are unique in their declared scope
trajectory task and split resolve to exactly one declared task
trajectory provenance resolves to one declared source
trajectory steps are contiguous and ordered
transition task, parent trajectory, and step identities agree
decision-state task and prompt profile agree with the run policy
success, terminal status, and replay status combinations are coherent
continuous rewards and optional binary success remain valid
